elo.note: chosen on development log loss from the pre-registered grid; hca=50 is the grid's lower edge (recorded, not extended)

selection_rule: default unless a candidate has holdout log loss lower with paired-bootstrap 95% CI (seed 20260924, 2000 resamples) excluding zero
prediction_gate: A if selected slope 95% bootstrap CI includes 1 AND every band n>=200 has predicted mean inside realised 99.5% Wilson interval; B if one of the two; C if neither
